captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a countertop bread maker with a light gray rectangular body, rounded vertical edges, and a matching top lid featuring a rectangular viewing window. The front interface consists of a black rotating dial and three small rectangular push buttons arranged on a raised control panel, along with a latch release button on the front face just below the lid. The lid is connected to the main body via a rear horizontal hinge, allowing it to swing upward to reveal the internal baking cavity.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a countertop bread maker with a rectangular body, rounded corners, and a top-hinged lid featuring a small central viewing window. Incorporate a front control panel with a rotating dial, three small push buttons, and a lid-release button, ensuring proper kinematic definitions for the rotating lid and dial.
captions.factory: The code constructs the bread maker by first defining a main housing body using a box primitive with vertical edge fillets. It hollows out a baking cavity inside the housing and adds a front control panel with a black rotary dial cylinder and three rectangular prismatic buttons. The lid is constructed as a separate flat box with a central rectangular cutout for the window and is connected to the body via a revolute joint along the rear horizontal axis.
